title: Treasure Island
author: d'après Robert Louis Stevenson
desc: Jim trouve la carte d'un trésor de pirates et part en mer… avec un cuisinier à une jambe très gentil. Trop gentil ?

p: Jim Hawkins lived with his mother in a small inn by the sea, in England. One day, an old sailor with a scar on his face came to stay. He drank a lot of rum and sang the same song every night: "Fifteen men on a dead man's chest, yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!"
He paid Jim a coin every month. "Keep your eyes open for a seaman with one leg," he said. "Tell me if you see him."
One night, a blind man came to the inn and gave the old sailor a black spot of paper. It was a pirate's death message. The old sailor fell to the floor. He was dead.
In his sea chest, Jim found an old map. On it, there was an island, and a red cross. *Here is the treasure.*
Jim showed the map to his friends, Doctor Livesey and Squire Trelawney. The squire was rich and excited. "We will buy a ship and find this treasure!"
They bought a ship called the Hispaniola. Captain Smollett was the captain. The squire found a cook, a friendly man with one leg and a parrot on his shoulder. His name was Long John Silver.
Jim liked Silver very much. Silver told him wonderful stories about the sea. His parrot always shouted: "Pieces of eight! Pieces of eight!"
One night, near the island, Jim was hiding in an apple barrel. He heard Silver talking to some sailors.
"When we have the treasure, we kill them all," said Silver.
Jim's blood went cold. Silver was a pirate!
When they arrived at the island, the pirates took the ship. Jim and his friends went to an old wooden fort on the island. There was a battle with the pirates.
Jim ran into the forest alone. There he met a strange man with a long beard and clothes made of goat skin. His name was Ben Gunn. He was a pirate who had lived alone on the island for three years.
"I'll tell you a secret," Ben Gunn said with a strange laugh. "The treasure… it isn't there anymore. I found it. I moved it to my cave!"
Then Jim had a crazy idea. At night, he took a small boat, swam to the Hispaniola, and took back the ship from the two drunk pirates on it.
The next day, Silver and the pirates followed the map to the red cross. They dug and dug. But the hole was empty. Only one old coin.
The pirates were furious. They wanted to kill Silver. But at that moment, the doctor, the squire and Ben Gunn arrived with their guns. The pirates ran away.
In Ben Gunn's cave, there were mountains of gold: coins, bars, jewels.
They loaded the treasure on the Hispaniola and sailed home. They took Silver as a prisoner. But one night, in a port, Silver disappeared with a bag of gold. Nobody ever saw him again.
Jim was rich now. But he never wanted to go back to Treasure Island. Sometimes, at night, he still hears the parrot in his dreams: "Pieces of eight! Pieces of eight!"
